free_tier_limits.correction: 14-day free trial with 50 free checks; extra services may still be charged

rate_limits.correction: Default limits: 300 GET requests per 5 seconds and 50 POST requests per 5 seconds; increases are available on request

description.correction: Sumsub exposes REST APIs for applicant and document data, status/results, transaction monitoring, and Travel Rule workflows, but liveness and face authentication checks are performed through its WebSDK or MobileSDK rather than requested directly through the REST API.

notes: Current official documentation remains active. The entry misses Sumsub's 14-day/50-check trial and published default rate limits. It also overstates REST coverage for biometric checks: face authentication requires the WebSDK or MobileSDK, though results can be retrieved by API. Official documentation did not establish a CORS policy.
